content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-97 as bundled, and there is no identified coding or billing-order error that supports a corrected resubmission. Prior authorization was not required, retro authorization is unavailable, and billing the patient for a payer bundling denial would be improper; a formal appeal is the available payer-compliant path to establish that CPT 93271 was separately necessary and payable.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
